description: Look up DNS records for a domain (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA, CAA, SRV) and report whether SPF and DMARC are published. Uses this machine's resolver, so the answers are whatever it returns, cache and all. A record type whose query failed is listed in checks_skipped rather than reported as absent. Network: needs DNS.
name: dns_lookup
